newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Banks mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.

text.p: Solidere was steady while bank and industrial shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday.
Solidere A and B shares were unchanged at $10.25 and $10.75 respectively on turnover of 85,525 shares from 129,687 with high supply on A shares.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose to $13.875 from $13.75 a day earlier and Banque Audi held steady at $19.125.
A total of 509 Audi shares were traded in a block outside the floor at $19.25.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.45 percent to 119.56 while the BLOM stock index rose 0.02 percent to 902.81 and the LISPI rose 0.25 percent to 84.97.
Industrial pipemaker Eternit rose to $2 from $1.9687 with 7,000 shares changing hands from Wednesday's 10,760.
Ciments Libanais was unchanged at $1.1875 on turnover of 100 shares. A block of 25,000 shares was traded on the floor at $1.25.
There was no trade in the two other listed firms: Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 139,940 shares for a value of $1,327,102 against 153,975 shares for a value of $1,607,030 on Wednesday.
